written: 2026-11-05, before any embedding of these sentences exists
note: Independent of v1: new fictional users, companies, places and people; no v1 sentence or question reused (checked by the runner). Synthetic and non-personal. Each user is scored on their OWN passages only, as recall is per owner. `day` = days after a fixed origin; conversations group passages as separate chats.

labels.relevant: must reach the prompt (selected) for the question
labels.excluded: must NOT be selected (keyword traps, someone else's fact, a different meaning)
labels.current: the latest true statement among the relevant ones (old and current must both be quoted)
labels.favours: which retrieval alone is expected to succeed: keyword (exact identifiers / shared rare words), semantic (different words, same meaning), both (shared words and meaning)

mara.about: Founder of Quillbrook, a fictional bookbinding-software startup in Utrecht

passages.text: We just signed our first enterprise customer, Halvorsen Print.
My goal this quarter is to hire a head of sales.
Our burn rate is about $80k a month.
We are building a mobile app called Inkwell.
The sales tax rules for printed books changed in the spring.
I bought a new spending tracker notebook for my desk.
The office plants need watering twice a week.
A colleague recommended a podcast about typography.
We shelved the Inkwell app to focus on the web product.
Theo accepted our offer and starts as head of sales next month.
Our monthly spending is now closer to $95k after the new hires.
I think we might move the team to Rotterdam, but nothing is decided.
Halvorsen Print renewed their contract for two more years.
The Rotterdam idea is off; we're staying in Utrecht.
Invoice QB-2291 from our cloud provider is overdue.

dev.about: A fictional secondary-school teacher at Larchmont Academy

passages.text: I teach chemistry at Larchmont Academy.
I'm training for the Riverside 10K in May.
My plan is to write a textbook on lab safety.
My sister runs a bakery in Ashford.
The school's boiler broke in January.
I collect old maps of coastal towns.
We adopted a rescue greyhound named Pepper.
The parent-teacher evening is on the 14th.
Larchmont asked me to take over the physics classes too.
I finished the 10K in 48 minutes!
The textbook project is on hold indefinitely; no time.
Starting in September I'll be head of the science department.
Actually, I was wrong earlier: the 10K was in April, not May.
Maybe I'll try a half marathon next year, not sure yet.
